sections.title: Hotfix Update
sections.description: This is a bug fix patch. Replay codes from March 10, 2026 patch are still available.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
sections.description:
- Fixed an issue that resulted in Jetpack Cat's Claws Out Perk cooldown being 8 seconds instead of the intended 6 seconds.
- Fixed an issue that caused some Knockbacks or Pulls to have reduced distances.
